### Luxury 2-Bedroom Apartment for Rent in Arthouse Mérida – Altabrisa

Are you looking for the perfect blend of art, comfort, and exclusivity in the best city to live in Mexico? This brand-new, modern apartment in the prestigious **Arthouse Mérida** building offers a unique residential experience in the heart of the Altabrisa zone.

**Sophisticated Interior Space** This unit is designed with an emphasis on space and natural light. With **100 m² of interior living area** and an additional **13 m² private terrace**, you have plenty of room to relax or entertain guests while enjoying the breeze of the Yucatán.

The apartment features a functional layout including:

*   **2 Spacious Bedrooms:** Each designed to be a private sanctuary.
*   **2 Modern Bathrooms:** Featuring high-end finishes and contemporary fixtures.
*   **Equipped Kitchen:** Ready for use with a refrigerator and water heater already installed.
*   **Climate Control:** High-efficiency A/C units in all areas to ensure your comfort year-round.
*   **Parking:** 2 dedicated parking spots for your convenience and security.

**The Arthouse Lifestyle** Living in Arthouse is not just about having a roof over your head; it’s about living within a curated art gallery. As a resident, you will have access to world-class amenities that set a new standard for luxury in Mérida:

*   Stunning swimming pool and sundeck.
*   State-of-the-art fitness center.
*   Social lounge, library, and private cinema.
*   24/7 security and concierge service.
*   Art-focused common areas featuring curated collections.

**Unbeatable Location** Located in the Altabrisa area, you are minutes away from the city’s top hospitals (El Faro, Star Médica), luxury shopping malls (Altabrisa, City 32), and the best dining options Mérida has to offer.

**Rental Details:**

*   **Monthly Rent:** $36,000 MXN (HOA/Maintenance fees included).
*   **Condition:** Brand New / First-time rental.

**Experience upscale living in Mérida’s most sought-after neighborhood.**

Located in the exclusive **Tarento** residential complex in Temozón Norte, this brand-new apartment offers a seamless blend of contemporary design, 24/7 security, and top-tier comfort. Perfect for those seeking a sophisticated lifestyle in a strategic location.

### Apartment Features:

This unit is move-in ready and **fully furnished** with high-quality decor.

*   **Full Climate Control:** Equipped with Air Conditioning (mini-splits) in every room, including living and dining areas.
*   **Open Concept Design:** Bright and airy living space with premium finishes.
*   **Gourmet Kitchen:** Modern kitchen featuring granite countertops and sleek cabinetry.

### World-Class Amenities:

Tarento offers more than just a home; it provides a complete lifestyle experience with exclusive facilities:

*   **Wellness:** Fully equipped **Gym** and a stunning swimming pool.
*   **Entertainment:** Relax at the **Rooftop Bar**, host gatherings in the social area, or enjoy the **Games Room**.
*   **Work from Home:** A dedicated **Business Center** designed for professional productivity.
*   **Security:** Gated community with a **Security Booth** and 24/7 surveillance for your peace of mind.

### Pricing & Maintenance:

*   **Monthly Rent:** $20,000 MXN.
*   **HOA Fees:** Included! Enjoy all building amenities and security with no extra monthly costs.

**Location:** Minutes away from La Isla Cabo Norte, City Center, and Faro del Mayab Hospital. Easy access to the highway to Progreso.

Located just 3 blocks from the Periférico and near Universidad Modelo, this townhouse is ideal for those seeking comfort and accessibility in one of Mérida’s most peaceful areas.

*   Spacious living-dining area with an open kitchen.
*   Half bathroom.
*   Laundry room.
*   Terrace with garden area and pool.
*   Covered parking for 2 cars.

**Upper Floor:**

*   2 bedrooms with walk-in closets.

**Second Level:**

*   TV room.
*   Rooftop terrace.

### **Amenities:**

*   Air conditioners and ceiling fans.
*   Water pressure pump.
*   Water heater.

*   Minimum contract term: 12 months.

*   Furniture and appliances are solely for staging purposes and are not included.
*   The property price does not include notary fees or taxes.
*   Final price may vary depending on the chosen payment method.

Discover our **BLOG** with all the information you need about the real estate market in Yucatán by clicking [here](https://balamgroup.com.mx/blog)

* * *

### Exclusive Upgrades and Private Retreats

The exterior of the home is a testament to quality and sophisticated design. A major selling point is the private outdoor oasis. The rooftop terrace is equipped with its own **private plunge pool**, an ideal space to relax, entertain, and enjoy stunning sunset views over the coastal skyline. Practicality is further addressed with dedicated aluminum storage cabinets on the rooftop, keeping the space clutter-free.

The curb appeal is immediately striking, highlighted by an elegant **white stone driveway** that provides durability and a sophisticated entrance. The aesthetic continues with custom upgrades like the calming **spa blue accent wall** and durable pavers in the kitchen patio area. Privacy and security are paramount; the installation of stunning **Zapote wood privacy walls** in both the front and back of the home—along with a secure **aluminum door** leading to the backyard—provides a tranquil, secluded environment. The property also features private parking for convenience.

### Community Amenities and Prime Location

Beyond the walls of your private retreat, the exclusive **Privada Puerto Arrecifes community** offers a suite of shared amenities designed to enrich the coastal lifestyle. Residents enjoy access to a communal pool, a dedicated BBQ and social area with convenient bathrooms, and a secure playground for the little ones.

Situated merely 300 meters from the glittering turquoise Gulf of Mexico and walking distance to popular **Chelem beachfront restaurants**, this location is unbeatable. Whether you are searching for a permanent residence, a luxurious vacation home, or a strategic **Yucatán beach investment** with high rental potential, this meticulously upgraded property is move-in ready and perfectly positioned to capitalize on the region’s growing popularity. This is one of the premier **Yucatan beach homes for sale** on the market today. Don’t miss this opportunity to secure your dream **modern home in Chelem**. Campoviento: Your Investment Opportunity in Yucatan Land, Sisal

Discover Campoviento, an exclusive real estate development in Sisal, Yucatan, that redefines real estate investment. Presented by Krea Desarrollos in 2025 , Campoviento offers spacious areas full of nature and the opportunity to live in a planned community with high capital gains.

**Why Invest in Campoviento and Yucatan?**

Yucatan has become a magnet for international companies, driving economic development and positioning the city as a hub of global opportunities. Major companies like Mercado Libre, Tesla, Heineken, and Amazon have chosen to invest in the region. Furthermore, Yucatan is recognized for its advanced security technology, implementing state-of-the-art tracking and monitoring systems to guarantee the well-being and protection of its inhabitants.

Investing in real estate in Yucatan offers returns superior to inflation and is an asset that always generates capital gains, allowing you to achieve financial freedom. Real estate occupancy in Yucatan has averaged 55% in recent years, surpassing other Mexican states like Chiapas (40%), Michoacán (48%), Puebla (49%), and Querétaro (50%). Specifically, in coastal areas like Sisal, hotel/residential occupancy reached 51.66% in recent months, with destinations like Sisal offering various accommodation options.

**Strategic Connectivity:**

Campoviento boasts a privileged location, connecting you with nature and the beauty of the sea. It is just 15 minutes (15 km) from Sisal beaches and 37 minutes (37 km) from Mérida City. Additionally, the International Airport is 52 minutes (52 km) away and Puerto Progreso 60 minutes (70 km) away. The Maya Train, with its sections 3 and 4 (Calkiní Izamal and Izamal Cancún), will improve mobility and connect you with the heart of southern Mexico , including nearby stations and stops like Teya Mérida, Umán, Maxcanú, and Valladolid.

**The Campoviento Development:**

Campoviento is a unique development in the region due to its exclusivity, offering a variety of residential lots starting from $150/m². The lots are strategically distributed in three private sections: Sampumunto, Praderas, and Arboledas. The first private section, Veredas, will have 258 exclusive lots.

**First-Class Amenities and Services:**

Campoviento stands out for its first-class amenities and services that promote your quality of life and make your investment more valuable. Among the 19 amenities included are:

*   Club House

*   Outdoor Gym

*   Orchards

*   Zen Park

*   Lake

Additionally, Campoviento offers exclusive amenities at its Beach Club, which include a restaurant, bar, sunbathing areas, exclusive boats, a social area, and restrooms, with 100 linear meters of beach and no membership fee.

**Investment Facilities:**

Invest in Yucatan land with lots starting from $160/m² and monthly payments from $5,500.00 MXN with a 60-month payment plan. Campoviento offers legal certainty and deed issuance upon completion of the purchase , as well as security and controlled access.

Don’t miss this incredible **Yucatan investment land** opportunity. Contact us today for more information about the **Yucatan investment land** at Campoviento!

#### Description

Located in the beautiful city of Valladolid, Copaura is the second most important city in the state of Yucatán, and the oldest in the state, known for its rich history and cultural attractions.

Here you can find countless historical sites, ancient mansions with great architectural wealth, museums, cozy boutique hotels, markets, fountains, art galleries, craft markets, a wide gastronomic offer, and of course the imposing San Bernardino de Siena convent, a tangible footprint of the Franciscan presence throughout the peninsula.

![Copaura](https://www.balamgroup.com.mx/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/52-7.png)

  
**Main Attractions:**

*   Handicrafts and culinary offerings
*   San Bernardino de Siena Convent
*   Zací, Xkekén, Samulá, and Suytun cenotes
*   San Servacio Church
*   Municipal Palace

**Location:**

Valladolid is situated right in the middle of the two most important cities in the Yucatán Peninsula, Mérida and Cancún, both approximately 160 kilometers away. It borders to the north with Temozón, to the south with Cuncunul–Tekom–Chichimila, to the east with Chemax, and to the west with Cuncunul-Uayma.

Nearby are located the main archaeological wonders of the area: Chichén Itzá only 45 km away, Tulum 100 km away, Ek Balam 30 km away, and Cobá 35 km away.  
  

##### Copaura, Your Home in a Magical Town

Copaura is part of the Yalconia project, a large development that houses 5 ancestral points united by nature, each marked by a Ceiba tree. The first marks the heart of Yalconia, the main access point of civilization, and the third is Capaura, the mystical land.

The third Ceiba tree of the Yalconia project represents the mystical land, the wisdom of the cosmos, and its connection to the magic of nature. It is a private residential complex, surrounded by nature and featuring luxury finishes in a mystical environment, designed for a relaxed lifestyle connected with nature, a magical place to start a new stage of life.

#### Description

Discover Nurento, an exclusive development of land for sale in Merida, Yucatan, strategically located in the San Ignacio area. This project has been carefully planned to be a point of reference for living and enjoying , offering the perfect balance between nature, an excellent location, and a lifestyle designed for every member of the family. Nurento is not just a place; it is a community where lines converge and life begins. It is the “perfect center” to live, invest, and enjoy.

### A Strategic Location: The Right Point between Merida and the Beach

Nurento is located on the Merida-Progreso highway, one of the city’s main connectivity routes. This privileged location allows you to enjoy the tranquility of nature while also having proximity to the city and the sea. Living in Nurento places you minutes away from a fast-growing urban area, with access to high-quality medical and educational services, and some of Mexico’s most beautiful beaches. The city of Merida, awarded as the safest in Latin America , is the perfect setting to make your dreams come true.

Thanks to its connectivity, the project is just a few minutes away from key points, such as:

Merida International Airport – 35 min

Foro GNP (Concerts) – 5 min

Anáhuac Mayab University – 10 min

The Harbor Fashion Mall – 10 min

Marista University – 12 min

Puerto Progreso – 15 min

Christus Muguerza Hospital – 15 min

### A Complete and Circular Lifestyle in Nurento

The Nurento Master Plan covers more than 3,000 m², surrounded by green areas, endemic vegetation, and top-level amenities. With a total of 176 lots, ranging in size from 192 m² to 399 m² , each plot is ready for development and features high-quality services and road infrastructure. The project was designed so that the amenities are the “meeting core,” fostering a growing life in zones created for uniting and sharing.

The amenities include:

*   Access Gate and Club House
*   Multi-purpose room for meetings and events
*   Gym, steam room, and sauna
*   Swimming pool, lap pool, and 2 jacuzzis
*   Padel, pickleball, and soccer 5 courts
*   Jogging track and Calisthenics area
*   Family areas like Kids Club, Kids Park, and Pet Park
*   Bar – Cafeteria and barbecue areas
*   Work Center and Mini Golf

### A Secure Investment with High Appreciation

Investing in Nurento is an excellent decision, as it is a project developed by Concreto Desarrollos, a local company that specializes in enhancing projects to guarantee a secure return on investment and appreciation for their clients. The available land plots are backed by a solid and well-planned project, making them the ideal option for those seeking an asset. Furthermore, the project’s design is a collaboration with Ápiron Arquitectura, a firm recognized for its focus on contemporary and sustainable design.

Nurento is your meeting place with nature and the charm of community. Don’t miss the opportunity to acquire one of these land plots for sale in Merida, Yucatan, a naturally destined place for you to live and prosper

#### Description

**Madre Ceiba: Your Premier Residential Investment Opportunity Near Mérida and Progreso**

Discover Madre Ceiba, an exclusive private residential development offering an unparalleled lifestyle in San Ignacio, Yucatán. Strategically located between the charming towns of San Ignacio and Dzidzilche, Madre Ceiba boasts a privileged position just 20 minutes from the port of Progreso and a mere 15 minutes from the northern Mérida ring road. This prime location provides residents with the tranquility of a private community while ensuring easy access to urban conveniences and coastal attractions, making it an ideal choice for discerning homeowners and astute investors.

Madre Ceiba comprises 733 residential lots, ranging from 240 m$^2$ to a generous 1123 m$^2$, meticulously organized into 11 clusters and developed in three stages. This diverse offering ensures a perfect fit for various needs, whether you’re seeking a compact plot for a custom-built home or a more expansive estate. The development operates under a condominium regime, providing a secure and well-managed environment for all residents.

**Exceptional Amenities for an Elevated Lifestyle**

Madre Ceiba is designed to provide a comprehensive and luxurious living experience, with an array of top-tier amenities. The main entrance features a vigilance booth for controlled access, complemented by a secondary entrance for suppliers and services, ensuring privacy and security. The development boasts robust infrastructure, including a main hydraulic concrete road connecting all clusters and amenities. This primary thoroughfare features a 5-meter road flow with 2-meter shoulders on each side, separated by a 3-meter median, and 1.5-meter sidewalks for pedestrian access. Secondary roads within the clusters are also made of hydraulic concrete, with a 6-meter road flow, 2-meter shoulder, an 0.80-meter median strip, and 1.20-meter sidewalks.

The crown jewel of Madre Ceiba is its fully equipped Casa Club, offering an extensive range of recreational and social facilities:

*   **Sports Amenities**: Enjoy an active lifestyle with paddle tennis courts, pickleball courts, a multi-purpose court, a swimming lane, a well-equipped gymnasium, sauna, showers, and lockers.
*   **Social Spaces**: Socialize and relax at the restaurant, various terraces, adult and children’s pools, a bar, Juniors Club, Kids Club, a dedicated coworking area, and a spacious event hall. Children will also delight in the dedicated play areas.

Beyond the Casa Club, each cluster within Madre Ceiba features its own parks, offering additional recreational opportunities such as social areas, sports courts, a pet park, green areas, parking, a jogging track, and play areas.

**Thoughtful Infrastructure and Services**

Madre Ceiba prioritizes comfort and convenience with its comprehensive service infrastructure. Public lighting illuminates all roads and amenities. A robust irrigation system maintains the lush common green areas. The development also features a system of rainwater collection wells with varying depths for optimal drainage. Each lot includes a connection point to the sanitary drainage network, though clients are responsible for installing a biodigester to optimize the system. Potable water is supplied directly to each lot from the development’s own pumping station, with water treated and chlorinated for use. Furthermore, every lot has an electrical connection point to the distribution network.

**Investment Potential and Regulations**

Madre Ceiba offers an exceptional investment opportunity, combining high-quality residential living with a competitive price point. The residential lots are designated for single-family use, with a maximum height restriction of 9.5 meters and a maximum of three permitted levels, including a roof garden. All construction projects require prior approval from the condominium’s construction committee to maintain aesthetic and structural integrity.

As a purchaser, you will be responsible for contracting individual services for your private area, as well as clearing, leveling, and cleaning your lot. The condominium will be managed by a specialized property administration company , and comprehensive regulations, including construction, landscaping, and common area usage guidelines, will be defined in the constitutive act of the regime. Maintenance fees will commence once the condominium regime is formalized and the administrator begins their duties.

With its strategic location, premium amenities, robust infrastructure, and competitive pricing, Madre Ceiba presents a compelling opportunity for those seeking a high-quality residential lifestyle or a smart investment in the thriving Yucatán real estate market. The current market conditions make this an opportune moment to invest in a property that promises both comfort and significant appreciation.

#### Description

### Yucalpeten Resort Marina | the best investment in the Coast

Yucalpeten Resort Marina is the first residential community by the sea on the Yucateca coast, a development that offers a new lifestyle, with nautical experiences that will make your days unique and unforgettable. It comprises a unique master plan that includes a beach club with incomparable amenities, a luxurious commercial town, a residential area, a marina and a boutique hotel. Everything you need to live surrounded by luxury and comfort 365 days a year, in Progreso Yucatán.

Be an investment pioneer in the area and turn your vision into a lifetime of unique experiences; life, relaxation, gastronomy, entertainment, nautical and exclusivity.

##### Location:

The location is great, it allows a quick connection with the United States, Europe, Central and South America, making it a point of great attraction for investors and developers.

##### Residential:

4 Residential Towers throughout the complex will be filled with the lives and daily activities of the residents. The project will have 139 apartments, 13 penthouses, 25 villas with 2, 3 and 4 bedrooms.

#### Description

INFINITI MERIDA is an exclusive residential project strategically located in the thriving city of Mérida, Yucatán, situated on a plot of approximately 34,000 square meters along Av. Cámara de Comercio, north of the city and within the perimeter of the ring road.

This development offers a secure and controlled environment, with two main entrances equipped with surveillance systems to ensure the tranquility of its residents.

With a carefully planned layout, the project consists of 613 units divided into seven buildings, which are classified into three different types:

*   2 type A buildings.
*   4 type B buildings.
*   1 type C building.

Each of these buildings offers a variety of housing options, ranging from apartments of approximately 82 m2 to 198 m2, including 35 exclusive Garden House apartments with exclusive garden areas.

In the first phase of development, tower B1 and tower A2 will be built, along with a wide range of amenities including:

*   Controlled vehicular and pedestrian access booth.
*   Closed-circuit television (CCTV) system in specific areas.
*   INFINITI GARDEN, a vast car-free space of approximately 9,000 m2.
*   Covered parking for residents and visitors.
*   Emergency power plant for essential services.
*   Sports facilities such as paddle tennis courts, multi-sports courts, and children’s play area.
*   Aquapark / Pool.
*   Pet park area.
*   Snack bar.
*   Jogging track.
*   Playroom.
*   Teens room.
*   Gym (first section).

As construction progresses in subsequent phases, the rest of the amenities detailed in the contract will be delivered.

The apartments will be delivered fully equipped with high-quality finishes, including:

*   Walls adjoining common areas made of cement block or similar, and interior walls of drywall.
*   National marble floors in main areas.
*   Integral kitchens with granite countertops and appliances.
*   Complete carpentry with doors, locks, closets, and dressing rooms.
*   Air conditioning.
*   Complete electrical installation with lighting fixtures and accessories.
*   Bathrooms with cabinets, mirrors, and accessories.
*   Tempered glass enclosures in showers.

In addition, each apartment has two covered parking spaces, with the option to acquire more subject to availability, as well as storage units available in basements.

Upon completion of all stages, the project will offer over 27,000 square meters of green areas, a lake, and a variety of car-free amenities. Designed for all ages and needs, INFINITI MERIDA stands out for its focus on nature and integration of advanced technologies to minimize long-term operating costs.

\*Prices and availability are subject to change without notice.  
\*The section and/or down payment is part of the total value of the operation  
\*Furniture and equipment are only representative to set the spaces and are not included.  
\*The price of the property does not include notary fees and taxes.  
\*The final price may vary depending on the payment method chosen

El Sueño – Luxury Residential Lots in Puerta Mayab, Mérida, Yucatán

Discover an unparalleled opportunity to build your dream home within “El Sueño,” an exclusive collection of residential lots nestled inside the prestigious Puerta Mayab development in Mérida, Yucatán. Located just three minutes from the historic Dzibilchaltún ruins, the acclaimed Yucatán Country Club, and the private community of La Ceiba, this prime real estate offers a lifestyle of luxury, comfort, and security.

“El Sueño” presents 8 meticulously planned residential lots, each ranging from 3,400 m² to 3,900 m², set within a private condominium regime. These spacious lots provide ample room for custom architectural designs, ensuring privacy and exclusivity. The development features a private interior street and a unique artificial lake, creating a serene and picturesque environment. Direct access is available either through the main Puerta Mayab fractionation or via the convenient highway to Chablekal, offering excellent connectivity to Mérida’s vibrant city center and beyond.

The land use for these magnificent lots is strictly residential, guaranteeing a harmonious and upscale neighborhood. Prices are set at $1500 per square meter, with the final price depending on the specific lot size chosen by the client. Balam Group Real Estate accepts various forms of payment, including personal resources and all types of credit, making this an accessible investment for a wide range of buyers. Delivery of these lots is immediate, allowing you to begin construction of your bespoke residence without delay.

Puerta Mayab, where “El Sueño” is situated, is renowned for its exquisite design and commitment to nature. The development boasts a thoughtful infrastructure with a mix of white and stone streets, a grand main avenue, six lateral streets, and six roundabouts. Underground electricity ensures a clean aesthetic, while the abundant, meticulously maintained vegetation enhances the natural beauty of the surroundings, fostering an eco-friendly living experience.

Residents of Puerta Mayab enjoy an impressive array of world-class amenities designed to cater to every leisure and wellness need. The development features a 24-hour security gatehouse, providing peace of mind and a secure living environment. The exclusive Casa Club is a hub of activity, offering a well-equipped gymnasium, two tennis courts, a paddle court, a soccer field, and a sparkling swimming pool. For social gatherings, a spacious palapa is available, complemented by bathrooms with changing rooms, a steam room, and a sauna. Families will appreciate the dedicated children’s play area and ample parking.
